title: Research problem for evaluation-strength-contract-001
goal: Define the minimum evaluation-strength contract fields and gate behavior needed before planner and code scopes rely on candidate evaluations.
problem_statement: How should evaluation packets represent static-only versus execution-backed confidence without overclaiming readiness?
constraints: must not require planner artifacts before planner exists

repo_context.decision_target: whether to add evaluation_strength and evaluation_method semantics to research_evaluation_packet and downstream recommendation gates
repo_context.decision_consequence: changes whether static candidate evaluation can be distinguished from execution-backed validation before planner entry
repo_context.blocked_work_if_unanswered: planner and code-generation scopes may overtrust static evaluations and drift into unsupported quality claims

research_context.evidence_summary: Evaluation strength should explicitly label static, artifact-backed, and execution-backed evidence so downstream gates do not overclaim solution quality.
